en: ...There. It is done.
Ummm...Meena... What in the world does the word ‘Puff-Puff’ have to do with my future<FG><FH>
Forgive me. I only tell you what the cards told me. And they told me that your lucky word is ‘Puff-Puff’.
It is such an unusual word...I felt I had to share it with you...
‘Puff-Puff’, eh<FH> I can't even imagine what that might mean the future has in store...
Do not dwell on it too much, <F4><S3>. All will become clear in the fullness of time.
Before long, I am sure the mists of mystery will clear, and the power of Puff-Puff will be revealed to you. Have a wonderful day now...
<F4><S3>, do you have a moment to chat<FH>
Absolutely<FG> What is it, Maya<FH>
Tee hee hee hee<FG> There's something I want to do for you. A little...gift, from one girl to another.
What in the world are you talking about, Maya<FH>
Oh, don't worry. All will become clear soon enough<FG> Now, I'll just need you to close your pretty little peepers for me...
Umm...okay. How's this<FH>
Perfect<FG> Here I come, ready or not<FG>
Puff-Puff<FG>
Wh<MV><FG><FH>
And there we go<FG> A masterpiece, even if I do say so myself<FG>
What did you just do<FH> I felt something...soft and spongy on my face...
Why, I did your make-up, of course<FG> And I think it turned out rather nicely<FG>
Make-up<FH>
Tee hee hee<FG> Don't sound so surprised<FG> You're worth it, darling<FG>
In fact, I wouldn't be surprised if the boys all fall head over heels for you now you've had a makeover from the Magnificent Maya<FG>
Head over heels...<FH>
Arey, that gives me an idea<MV>why don't I do all the girls' faces<FH> Yes, that will be wonderful<FG> I'm off to do it now<FG>
<F4><S3>, do you have a moment<FH>
Are you alright, Jessica<FH> You're looking rather...purposeful.
Yes, umm... Well, there's something I was hoping you might be able to help me with...
It's just that... I wondered if you'd mind if I... Oh, it's too embarrassing to explain, I'll just have to go ahead and do it<FG>
Could you shut your eyes for me<FH>
Yes, of course, Jessica... There, they're shut.
Thanks<FG> Here I go, then<FG>
Puff-Puff<FG>
B-Blimey...
There, that's better<FG>
What in the world was that all about<FH> I felt something soft on either side of my face, it... Jessica<MV><FG><FH>
What<FH> I just squeezed your pretty little cheeks, that's all<FG>
They're just so soft and...scrumptious-looking<FG> I had to feel them for myself<FG>
Umm, I suppose that makes sense...sort of... So, err...how were they<FH>
Tee hee hee<FG> Oh, yes. They're every bit as juicy and lovely as I'd imagined<FG>
Ahhh, I feel so much better for doing that<FG> Thanks, <F4><S3><FG> You're an angel<FG>
Ah, <F4><S3>. Might I ask the pleasure of a moment of your time, my dear<FH>
Umm...sure.
There's something...important I want to introduce you to. A little...secret of mine...
A secret<FH> And what might that be<FH>
Let's not rush things<FG> First, could you close those beautiful eyes of yours<FH> I won't be able to carry on with you gazing at me like that.
Err...okay... How's this<FH>
Wonderful<FG> Now, brace yourself. Here it comes<FG>
Puff-Puff.
Uhhh...
All finished. What do you think<FH> Not bad, eh<FH>
I felt something soft and...squishy on my face... What... What was that, Angelo<FH>
Not what you were imagining, clearly. It was simply a pair of cooling, soothing slimes.
In my world, there are parlours specialising in this form of relaxation. I thought you might appreciate a taste of the...exotic...
Oh... Th-Thanks...
Just you come to me if you ever want a repeat performance. It will be...our little secret...
<F4><S3><FG> I require you to aid me in something of maximal import<FG>
Of course, Alena. What can I help you with<FH>
To forewarn in advance would be to impair your enjoyment<FG> For time being, it shall remain a mystery to you<FG>
Please, to close your eyes and anticipate with wonder<FG>
Okay. Is this alright<FH>
Perfect<FG> Now, to commence...
Puff-Puff<FG>
My performance is concluded<FG> Well<FH> You are flabbergasted and astounded, yes<FH>
Umm...I think so. Were you playing the trumpet or something<FH>
It was recognisable as such a noise<FH> Ura<FG> Then I am with success in my endeavours<FG>
You see, in recent days, I have witnessed Kiryl attempt covertly to practise trumpet-playing in his chambers.
I have resolved also to take on this instrument, and to surprise him with my excellence<FG> Perhaps we can even duet<FG>
So that's what this is all about<FG> Well, if that little performance was anything to go by, you'll be an expert in no time<FG>
This is my aim<FG> Kiryl shall not surpass me<FG> I shall practise until mastery is mine<FG>
Your attention is appreciated, <F4><S3><FG> My resolve in trumpeting is now absolute<FG>
Friend <F4><S3><MV>may I possibly borrow your time<FH>
Certainly, Kiryl<FG> What is it<FH>
I must request of you a favour, but it concerns a matter of...maximal sensitivity...
Don't worry<MV>your secret's safe with me<FG>
Ah, you are benevolent indeed<FG> Very well. Prior to commencing, I must require of you that you make your eyes closed.
Alright then, like this, right<FH>
Correct<FG> Now, to begin...
Puff-Puff.
It is concluded. Well<FH> What is your opinion<FH>
Well, umm... There was something soft and fluffy against my face, and...it felt nice, I suppose...
‘Nice’, you declare<FH> This is pleasing to me indeed<FG> Recently, you see, I am performing...night work, as perhaps you might say...
‘Night work’<FH> What have you been doing<FH>
Yes<FG> I labour and slave to create for Tsarevna a soft and luscious pillow, in order that she is capable to sleep soundly in this strange land<FG>
Finally last night I have completed it, but prior to gifting to Tsarevna, I wished to confirm its comfort and softness.
Ah, well it's an absolutely lovely pillow<MV>I'm certain Alena will love it<FG>
Wondrous<FG> Your seal of approval relieves and pleases me<FG> I shall present to Tsarevna the pillow forthwith<FG> One thousand thanks to you<FG>
NOT USED
NOT USED
NOT USED
NOT USED
Hmm... I see you young whippersnappers have been gathering ingredients. They can come in very handy, you know.
Well, most of them can. Others, like gold nuglets, aren't any use at all. You'd do well to just sell them and make some money.
It's an ancient gravestone. Carved into it is a prayer to a young maiden who lost her life here.
What's this<FH> There's something nestled in the snow on top of the grave...
<F4><S0> acquires a Bondstone<FG>
It seems the Beauty of the Bracing Boughs has left us a token of her appreciation. How sweet.
LoooOOOooong time, noooOOOooo see<FG> Things have been goooOOOoooing well since yoooOOOooou brought my partner back<FG>
But things don't seem to be goooOOOoooing so well for yoooOOOooou<FG> You must face a poooOOOooowerful enemy indeed<FG>
<F4><S0> receives a Bondstone<FG>
I hoooOOOooope it will help yoooOOOooou in your quest<FG> Don't give up<FG> We're all counting on yoooOOOooou<FG>
Ey up, you lot<FG> I hear you've actually been making a bit of an effort for once. Heh<FG> I've eyes and ears everywhere, see<FG>
Being as how you've finally pulled your finger out, I reckon you've earned this. Here. Take it, before I change me mind<FG>
<F4><S0> receives a Bondstone<FG>
That's it<FG> No more freebies for you<FG> But if you ever want to take a crack at one of me trials, you're more than welcome<FG>
Honoured disciple...you seem more...focused than when last we met. I see that you now have...a purpose.
Hrrrnnnnnnnnngh...\nHaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah<MV><FG><FG><FG>
<F4><S0> and <F4><S1> learn Zap<FG>
Honoured disciple...you are even more focused than when last we met. Your resolve has been tempered in the fires of battle<FG>
Hrrrnnnnnnnnngh...\nHaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah<MV><FG><FG><FG>
<F4><S0> and <F4><S1> learn Zapple<FG>
Hmm<FG> Your true power begins to reveal itself, honoured disciple. Every struggle you overcome hones your fighting spirit<FG>
Hrrrnnnnnnnnngh...\nHaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah<MV><FG><FG><FG>
<F4><S0> and <F4><S1> learn Kazap<FG>
I dearly wish I could fight beside you, but I am powerless to do so in this form<FG> At least allow me to give you this...
This is the aftermath of the Dreadbolt. All that remains is death...darkness...despair...and savage monsters of the cruelest kind...
Take this. May it aid you in your quest to put a stop to his wickedness...
But in the end, he could not bring himself to end Fractos's life. That was more than he could bear...
You can take this with you if you want<FG> It's not much use to me now...
King Unos had a super-special best friend<MV>a giant talking bird<FG> Isn't that amazing<FG>
It's hard to believe that he once followed the light just as Unos did...before everything changed...
Please, take this with you. I hope that it will help you in some small way...
Has he been plotting for all these years<FH> His depravity knows no bounds<FG>
Very well. Then the soldiers of Accordia are with you. May we stand together and reclaim our home<FG>
The path on the far side of this river leads to No Man's Land. I can carry you across on the raft if you'd like.
It would seem that your own quest for glory is only just beginning. But by performing dashing martial deeds, you too may rise to stardom<FG>
I feel a certain...kinship between us. Here, take this. May it serve you well on your journey to the dizzying heights of fame<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a wayfarer's orb<FG>
If you have the will, the skill and the strength to be a hero, then prove it<FG> Only through great deeds on the battlefield can glory be yours<FG>
But...are you not embarrassed to be seen wearing it<FH> Such adornments are solely the province of preening maidens<FG>
I want to help yoooOOOooou, but I cannot leave my post. So please, take this. It's the least I can doooOOOooo<FG>
Perhaps you would be interested in pushing the bounds of proficiency even further<FH> ...Very well. I deem you worthy to take my trial.
I will leave instructions with the questmistress. Speak with her if you wish to take the test. Honoured disciple, I wish you luck.
Very well. Close your eyes, and I will bestow upon you a power that will help you to achieve it.
You show great promise. Close your eyes, and I will bestow upon you a yet greater power that will help you reach your full potential<FG>
You have proven yourself time and again. I do not doubt you worthy of this power I bestow upon you. Now, close your eyes...
We've finally managed to cut a path to the throne room. It's time the High King gave us some answers<FG>
Alriiight<FG> The path to throne room is clear<FG> I'd say it's high time the High King explained himself<FG>
I... I did it<FG> (slurp) Any time you need a barrier dispelling, I'm your slime<FG>
We must not keep the twin kings waiting. Let's go.
The High King is waiting for us on the other side of the throne room doors. I'd say it's high time we paid him a visit.
When all this is over, d'ye think yer wan the Queen might sell me that Lapis Leveli<FH> I could make a tidy profit on a handy yoke like that<FG>
Just you wait, you silly old men<FG> I'm going to make you pay for all the times I've had to climb up all those stupid stairs<FG>
Cor, Healix was brilliant back there<FG> I'll have to buck my ideas up if I want to be as cool as him<FG>
What're the High Kings planning up there anyhow<FH> Nothing good, I'll bet.
We have dispelled the barrier that blocked our way. Now we must press on into the throne room<MV>it is our destiny<FG>
I can't believe Healix managed to bring down that big, bad barrier all on his own... He's pretty powerful for a blob of jelly<FG>
The barrier's down, is it<FH> Excellent. What say we pay those twin kings a little visit<FH>
Throne room is just to reverse of double doors, yes<FH> Then let us to proceed inwards without additional ado<FG>
And look at the monster medal holder<MV>Fractos's influence must be stopping it from working properly.
Platypunks have been attacking travellers in the northern part of Greena Pastures. Noble hero<MV>will you drive them away<FH>
Now it seems that an axe-wielding fiend is prowling the woods toward Accordia. Will you drive this beast away for us also<FH>
Dear Goddess<FG> An enormous monster has appeared in Harba, and is running amok<FG> Please, you must save the town<FG>
Help meee<FG><FG><FG>\nI'm surrounded by monsters<FG>
Phew<FG> You really saved my bacon<FG> Thanks so much<FG>
Oh, by the way, there's this masked monster making trouble in the woods to the south. Can you teach him a lesson<FH>
Wow<FG> You made short work of that hooded rascal<FG> You lot are something else<FG> Oh, but this is no time for small talk<FG>
That monster's going to smash Harba to bits<FG> Get over there and save the town<FG>
A ginormous monster is running rampant in Harba<FG> If you think you can help, please, you have to go there right away<FG>
If you cast Zoom, you can be there in an instant<FG> Hurry<FG> The town needs you<FG>
That's the end of the demo.\nThanks so much for playing<FG>
We hope you'll look forward to the rest of the game<FG>
Who... WHO<FG><FH> Who would disturb my sleeeeeep<FG><FH>
So, thou art come before me at last<FG> I am the Dragonlord, master of masters, king of kings<FG>
(sigh)
Umm... Is something the matter<FH> I don't mean to pry, but you look like you've got a lot on your mind...
Hm<FH> Oh, well...it's my husband, you see. He's going away. Off to far-flung shores to sell his wares...
And it's our anniversary the day he leaves, so... So I want to make him a lovely packed lunch to take, full of all his favourite things...
Well, that's a grand idea altogether<FG> There's no better way to a feller's heart than through his stomach, after all<FG>
But you don't understand<FG> I won't be able to make it in time<FG> I can't find any of the ingredients I need<FG> Ohhh, this is a disaster<FG>
So that's why she's so down in the dumps, eh<FH> Poor woman.
Ah now, don't be gettin' yerself upset. Would ye be willin' to let ourselves have a hunt for these ingredients ye're after<FH>
You... You'd do that for me<FH> ...Well, if it's not too much to ask, I'd be ever so grateful...
Sure, an' it's no problem at all, at all<FG> We can't be lettin' these precious plans o' yours come to nuttin' now, can we<FH>
Oh, thank you<FG> You're so kind<FG>
If you could bring me what I need to put the finishing touches on my husband's special packed lunch, I'd be ever so grateful...
Thank you so much for finding that leaf of true lovage for me<FG> I don't know what I would have done without you<FG>
Ah, think nuttin' of it<MV>'tis the least we can do<FG> I'm sure yer feller'll be over the moon about this packed lunch o' yours<FG>
I do hope so... If I can ever finish it...
Huh<FH> You don't sound too confident. Don't tell me there's something else you're missing<FH>
Well, there is one thing<MV>an extremely rare fish known as a wed herring...
There's an old legend that says if a husband and wife share one, their love will never fade for as long as they live.
Jaykers<FG> Could there be a more fittin' fish for yer man's dish<FH> Ye'll be needin' one o' those, an' no mistake<FG>
I wish we could help, but if they're as rare as you say, how will we ever find one<FH>
I don't know if there's any truth to the rumours, but I've heard that they're occasionally caught off the coast of Harba...
Then hey-ho, an' off to Harba we go<FG> I mightn't look it, but I've always been lucky<MV>I'll find ye that fish if it's the last thing I do<FG>
R-Really<FG><FH> Oh, thank you, thank you<FG> You don't know how much this means to me<FG>
I'm ever so sorry to ask another favour of you, but if you could bring me one, I'd be eternally grateful<FG>
A little bird tells me that wed herrings are sometimes caught off the coast of Harba. If I were you, I'd make that my first port of call<FG>
How can I ever repay you<FH> Thanks to you, I was able to make my husband the perfect packed lunch for our anniversary<FG>
Well, that's grand altogether<FG> So, how did yer man like his little treat<FH>
I don't know<MV>I wanted it to be a surprise, so I gave it to him without saying anything. He's probably opening the lid right about now...
Sure, an' I bet he'll be beamin' from ear to ear when he sees all the trouble ye've been to<FG>
Yes... I hope so... I only wish he could have stayed. Then we could have enjoyed an anniversary meal together instead...
And thanks to you, I can at least be with him in spirit. I'm so grateful for everything you've done<FG>
Well, she certainly seems happy. Not a bad day's work, eh, Torneko<FH>
Aye... But seein' her so cut up at bein' left on her lonesome like that, it... It doesn't half make a man feel guilty... (sniff)
See, whenever I set off on me own adventures, my Tessie always packs me a little lunch an' sends me on me way with a smile.
But she's probably just like yer wan there<MV>stuck at home wishin' we could be tuckin' in together instead...
Well, it is always nicer to share a meal than to eat alone...
Right, so<MV>it's decided<FG> Soon as this world's at peace an' I've found a way back, it's straight to the auld homestead for Torneko Taloon<FG>
An' the first thing I'll do is get Tessie an' Tipper round the table fer a slap-up feast the like o' which they've never seen<FG>
Cor blimey... My life, eh<FH>
Are you alright there<FH> You look a bit down in the dumps. Has something happened<FH>
You can say that again, guv. I've 'ad a letter from me dear old mum. Me sister's come down wiv the dreaded lurgy...
She's sick, huh<FH> Well, feelin' sorry for yourself ain't gonna help none, bud. Ya gotta go see her<FG>
You fink I don't want to<FH> I can't, mate, that's the problem<MV>the only bridge back to me 'ometown's gone and got washed away.
Wivout it, I ain't got no way o' gettin' back. Which is why I'm standin' 'ere like a lemon, prayin' the poor kid pulls through...
Your sister needs your help, huh<FH>
...Yeah. Wot's it to you<FH>
...Nothing. Hey, Carver<MV>you know how to work wood, right<FH> Reckon you can fix up that bridge<FH>
Sure thing<FG> Folks back home call me Mister Mediator<MV>'cause I'm always buildin' bridges<FG> Hardy har har<FG>
I can't help with the carpentry, but if you need help finding materials, just say the word.
Hoowee<FG> I never thought I'd see the day<FG> Terry, helpin' somebody outta the kindness of his heart<FG> Leave this with us, pal<FG>
Yer really gonna do this<FH> Fanks, you lot<FG> I owe ya one<FG>
Fanks for sayin' you'll 'elp fix that bridge. Let me know as soon as it's done, eh<FH>
Well, would ya look at that<MV>we got all the fixings we need to fix that bridge we're fixin' to fix<FG> Let's get to it<FG>
Oooi<FG> 'Old yer 'orses<FG>
Yer gonna need some seriously sturdy wood to finish the job. I'm talkin' Grade A lumber<FG>
The current in that bit o' the river's strong as anyfing, see. If you don't 'ave some well good wood for the pilings, the 'ole fing'll wash away.
And where are we supposed to get wood that good<FH>
That's the problem, innit<MV>the tree you need only grows in the Wildwood, an' the monsters ain't too keen on people choppin' 'em down.
The Wildwood, huh<FH> Lucky for us, we got some pals there that might be able to help us out. Ain't that right, Terry<FH>
Yup. We'll get the goods. Trust me<MV>you'll be back with your sister before you know it.
Cor... You lot are bleedin' brilliant<FG> If yer sure yer up for it, then get yerselves over to the Wildwood. Just...be careful, alright<FH>
The Wildwood's 'ome to some o' the 'orriblest monsters in the Seven Realms. Take care o' yerselves in there<FG>
Is it true<FG><FH> Did you lot really go down the Wildwood an' get some o' that well good wood I told you about<FH>
You bet we did<FG> Carver's already started fixing the broken bridge. He should be done any min<MV>
He's done.
Hey there, bud<FG> Sorry to keep you waitin', but I finally finished fixin' up that bridge. You can head home whenever you like<FG>
Wot, yer finished already<FG><FH> Cor blimey<FG> Yer a carpenter an' an 'alf, ain'tcha<FH>
That's wonderful news<FG> Now you can go and visit your family<FG>
Well<FH> Why are you still here<FH> Your sister needs you.
Yer right<FG> I'd best get a wriggle on<FG> Fanks a billion, you lot<FG> You've really 'elped me out<FG>
Aww yeah<FG> Another satisfied customer<FG> And how's about that carin' side o' yours, Terry<FH> You ain't nearly so cold as you make out<FG>
Heh. I have my moments. And so do you<MV>that bridge got fixed quick. You been practising<FH>
Does a beaver like to lunch on logs<FH> 'Course I have<FG> Ya don't get to be the best carpenter in the world if ya don't train every day<FG>
And besides, workin' wood works the same muscles as martial arts, so the more carpentry I do, the tougher I get<FG>
Whaddya say, Terry<FH> Wanna join me in choppin' a log or two thousand<FH> Who knows<MV>might put some meat on your bones<FG>
Thanks, but I'll pass. I got my own training regimen<MV>and it sure beats making firewood.
Honestly, he'll be the death of me, that boy... Where in the world has he run off to this time...<FH>
Sorry... Can we help you<FH> You look like you've got something on your mind.
Have I ever<FG> My little boy went off to play this morning, and I haven't seen hide nor hair of him since<FG>
And the little girl he's always playing with is nowhere to be seen either. Why must the little blighters worry me so<FH>
Oh, stop fretting. They're probably just too busy playing to notice the time. They'll be back for dinner, you'll see.
Yeah<FG> Whenever my tummy starts rumbling, playtime's over<FG>
But his games of adventurers always get so out of hand<MV>I'm petrified he's run clean out of town and off over the horizon<FG>
Ugh<FG> Why do boys always have to act like idiots and worry their poor parents<FH> They're the same no matter where you go<FG>
Don't worry<MV>we'll bring back your son, even if we have to drag him by the ears<FG> Come on, Ruff<MV>you're going to help<FG>
